verdict.rationale: Granola documents a native HubSpot integration that automatically saves notes added to Granola folders onto the relevant HubSpot contacts, companies, or deals. That covers the core of the story for one CRM, but routing depends on folder setup rather than automatic record matching. Nothing in the evidence shows native Salesforce or Attio sync; the generic Zapier and API options are building blocks, not this capability. Missing for 10: native Salesforce sync, native Attio sync, automatic contact/deal matching without folder setup, independent hands-on corroboration of HubSpot sync.

support.subject: As a sales lead, meeting notes and summaries sync automatically onto the right contact and deal records in my CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio)

citations.quote: You can set up Granola to automatically save any notes that are added to Granola folders to the relevant contacts, companies, or deals on HubSpot.
Sync Granola meeting notes to HubSpot. Automatically sync notes to CRM records from your meetings using folders.
